!3 Error cases: every row below is expected to raise
A missing file or a document that cannot be read is not a difference: the fixture raises, and FitNesse shows the cell in yellow with the message. All rows here are '''expected''' to be yellow.

|import|
|io.github.tortaje.compare|

|script|json comparison|
|check|compare file|src/test/resources/e2e/expected/missing.json|to file|src/test/resources/e2e/actual/order.json|OK|
|check|compare file|src/test/resources/e2e/expected/order.json|to file|src/test/resources/e2e/actual/missing.json|OK|
|check|compare;|!-{"a":1}-!|!-{"a":-!|OK|
|check|compare;|!-{"a":1,"a":2}-!|!-{"a":1}-!|OK|
|check|compare;|!-{"a":1}-!|!- -!|OK|
|check|compare;|!-{"a":"${nope}"}-!|!-{"a":"x"}-!|OK|
|check|compare;|!-{"a":"${regex:[0-9}"}-!|!-{"a":"1"}-!|OK|
